title: China Weird Food Map
synopsis: Explore the China Weird Food Map, and taste bizarre dishes such as century eggs, stinky tofu, raw garlic, and chicken feet. Experience the unique food culture and surprising tastes of different parts of China.

fullText.simplified:
中国奇葩食物地图

    食物，是我们每个人都离不开的东西。不同的国家有不同的食物，也有自己的食物文化。中国也是这样，不但有很多食物，而且每个地方的食物文化还不一样。这些食物文化中，“奇葩食物”是最特别的。
    奇葩食物和其他食物不同，喜欢这些食物的人很喜欢，不喜欢这些食物的人害怕它们。奇葩食物在很多地方都有，因为每个地方都有一些人喜欢它们，会找卖这些食物的地方。很难说这些奇葩食物是哪里的食物，这里只说几个最有名的。
    皮蛋。皮蛋是一种看起来黑黑的蛋，吃起来很特别。最早做皮蛋的人是江苏人，人们把蛋放在灰里，几个月以后蛋就会变黑。现在人们常常一边吃皮蛋一边喝啤酒，有人用皮蛋做菜，还有人把皮蛋放在米饭里。
    臭豆腐。臭豆腐，听名字就知道，是一种很臭的豆腐。最有名的臭豆腐在湖南，湖南人常常炸臭豆腐，再放一些绿色的菜。喜欢吃臭豆腐的人说，其实臭豆腐吃起来是不臭的。
    大蒜。很多人都吃大蒜，大蒜其实不太奇葩。但在中国北方，一些人喜欢吃生大蒜，而不是把大蒜放在菜里。喜欢吃生大蒜的人觉得大蒜很香，特别是和肉，还有面条一起吃的时候。
    鸡爪。和其他奇葩食物不一样，很多中国人都喜欢吃鸡爪。其实在中国，鸡爪不是奇葩食物，是很常见的。大家喜欢在饭店里一边吃米饭一边吃鸡爪；也喜欢在家里一边看电视一边吃鸡爪。
    这些是最有名的中国奇葩食物，还有一些不那么有名的奇葩食物，如果想知道更多，可以上网看看。虽然这些食物听起来很奇葩，但喜欢它们的人非常爱吃这些食物。如果你来到中国，可以试试这些特别的食物，也许你会发现自己喜欢上了它们。
fullText.traditional:
中國奇葩食物地圖

    食物，是我們每個人都離不開的東西。不同的國家有不同的食物，也有自己的食物文化。中國也是這樣，不但有很多食物，而且每個地方的食物文化還不一樣。這些食物文化中，“奇葩食物”是最特別的。
    奇葩食物和其他食物不同，喜歡這些食物的人很喜歡，不喜歡這些食物的人害怕它們。奇葩食物在很多地方都有，因為每個地方都有一些人喜歡它們，會找賣這些食物的地方。很難說這些奇葩食物是哪裡的食物，這裡只說幾個最有名的。
    皮蛋。皮蛋是一種看起來黑黑的蛋，吃起來很特別。最早做皮蛋的人是江蘇人，人們把蛋放在灰裡，幾個月以後蛋就會變黑。現在人們常常一邊吃皮蛋一邊喝啤酒，有人用皮蛋做菜，還有人把皮蛋放在米飯裡。
    臭豆腐。臭豆腐，聽名字就知道，是一種很臭的豆腐。最有名的臭豆腐在湖南，湖南人常常炸臭豆腐，再放一些綠色的菜。喜歡吃臭豆腐的人說，其實臭豆腐吃起來是不臭的。
    大蒜。很多人都吃大蒜，大蒜其實不太奇葩。但在中國北方，一些人喜歡吃生大蒜，而不是把大蒜放在菜裡。喜歡吃生大蒜的人覺得大蒜很香，特別是和肉，還有麵條一起吃的時候。
    雞爪。和其他奇葩食物不一樣，很多中國人都喜歡吃雞爪。其實在中國，雞爪不是奇葩食物，是很常見的。大家喜歡在飯店裡一邊吃米飯一邊吃雞爪；也喜歡在家裡一邊看電視一邊吃雞爪。
    這些是最有名的中國奇葩食物，還有一些不那麼有名的奇葩食物，如果想知道更多，可以上網看看。雖然這些食物聽起來很奇葩，但喜歡它們的人非常愛吃這些食物。如果你來到中國，可以試試這些特別的食物，也許你會發現自己喜歡上了它們。

sentences.traditional: 食物，是我們每個人都離不開的東西。不同的國家有不同的食物，也有自己的食物文化。

sentences.simplified: 中国也是这样，不但有很多食物，而且每个地方的食物文化还不一样。
sentences.traditional: 中國也是這樣，不但有很多食物，而且每個地方的食物文化還不一樣。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó yě shì zhè yàng bú dàn yǒu hěn duō shí wù ér qiě měi ge dì fang de shí wù wén huà hái bù yí yàng
sentences.english: Food is something we all can’t live without. Different countries have different foods and their own food cultures.

sentences.simplified: 这些食物文化中，“奇葩食物”是最特别的。
sentences.traditional: 這些食物文化中，“奇葩食物”是最特別的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shí wù wén huà zhōng qí pā shí wù shì zuì tè bié de
sentences.english: China is the same. Not only does it have a lot of food, but each place has a different food culture.
Among these food cultures, “weird food” is the most special.

sentences.simplified: 奇葩食物和其他食物不同，
sentences.traditional: 奇葩食物和其他食物不同，

sentences.traditional: 喜歡這些食物的人很喜歡，不喜歡這些食物的人害怕它們。

sentences.english: Weird foods are different from other foods.

sentences.simplified: 奇葩食物在很多地方都有，因为每个地方都有一些人喜欢它们，会找卖这些食物的地方。
sentences.traditional: 奇葩食物在很多地方都有，因為每個地方都有一些人喜歡它們，會找賣這些食物的地方。

sentences.english: People who like these foods like them a lot, and people who don’t like these foods are afraid of them.

sentences.simplified: 很难说这些奇葩食物是哪里的食物，这里只说几个最有名的。
sentences.traditional: 很難說這些奇葩食物是哪裡的食物，這裡只說幾個最有名的。
sentences.pinyin: hěn nán shuō zhè xiē qí pā shí wù shì nǎ lǐ de shí wù zhè lǐ zhǐ shuō jǐ ge zuì yǒu míng de
sentences.english: Weird foods are available in many places because every place has some people who like them and will look for places that sell these foods.
It is difficult to say where these weird foods come from. Here are only a few of the most famous.

sentences.simplified: 皮蛋。皮蛋是一种看起来黑黑的蛋，吃起来很特别。
sentences.traditional: 皮蛋。皮蛋是一種看起來黑黑的蛋，吃起來很特別。

sentences.simplified: 最早做皮蛋的人是江苏人，
sentences.traditional: 最早做皮蛋的人是江蘇人，
sentences.pinyin: zuì zǎo zuò pí dàn de rén shì jiāng sū rén
sentences.english: Century eggs. A century egg is a black-looking egg that has a very special taste.

sentences.simplified: 人们把蛋放在灰里，几个月以后蛋就会变黑。
sentences.traditional: 人們把蛋放在灰裡，幾個月以後蛋就會變黑。
sentences.pinyin: rén men bǎ dàn fàng zài huī lǐ jǐ ge yuè yǐ hòu dàn jiù huì biàn hēi
sentences.english: The first people who made century eggs were from Jiangsu.

sentences.simplified: 现在人们常常一边吃皮蛋一边喝啤酒，
sentences.traditional: 現在人們常常一邊吃皮蛋一邊喝啤酒，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài rén men cháng cháng yì biān chī pí dàn yì biān hē pí jiǔ
sentences.english: People put the eggs in ash, and after a few months, the eggs turned black.

sentences.simplified: 有人用皮蛋做菜，还有人把皮蛋放在米饭里。
sentences.traditional: 有人用皮蛋做菜，還有人把皮蛋放在米飯裡。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu rén yòng pí dàn zuò cài hái yǒu rén bǎ pí dàn fàng zài mǐ fàn lǐ
sentences.english: Nowadays, people often eat century eggs while drinking beer.
Some people cook with century eggs, and some people put century eggs in rice.

sentences.simplified: 臭豆腐。臭豆腐，听名字就知道，是一种很臭的豆腐。
sentences.traditional: 臭豆腐。臭豆腐，聽名字就知道，是一種很臭的豆腐。
sentences.pinyin: chòu dòu fu chòu dòu fu tīng míng zi jiù zhī dào shì yì zhǒng hěn chòu de dòu fu

sentences.simplified: 最有名的臭豆腐在湖南，湖南人常常炸臭豆腐，再放一些绿色的菜。
sentences.traditional: 最有名的臭豆腐在湖南，湖南人常常炸臭豆腐，再放一些綠色的菜。
sentences.pinyin: zuì yǒu míng de chòu dòu fu zài hú nán hú nán rén cháng cháng zhá chòu dòu fu zài fàng yì xiē lǜ sè de cài
sentences.english: Stinky tofu. Stinky tofu, as you can tell by the name, is a very smelly tofu.

sentences.simplified: 喜欢吃臭豆腐的人说，其实臭豆腐吃起来是不臭的。
sentences.traditional: 喜歡吃臭豆腐的人說，其實臭豆腐吃起來是不臭的。
sentences.pinyin: xǐ huan chī chòu dòu fu de rén shuō qí shí chòu dòu fu chī qǐ lái shì bú chòu de
sentences.english: The most famous stinky tofu is in Hunan. People in Hunan often deep-fry stinky tofu and put some greens on it.
People who like to eat stinky tofu say that it actually does not taste stinky.

sentences.simplified: 大蒜。很多人都吃大蒜，大蒜其实不太奇葩。
sentences.traditional: 大蒜。很多人都吃大蒜，大蒜其實不太奇葩。
sentences.pinyin: dà suàn hěn duō rén dōu chī dà suàn dà suàn qí shí bú tài qí pā

sentences.simplified: 但在中国北方，一些人喜欢吃生大蒜，而不是把大蒜放在菜里。
sentences.traditional: 但在中國北方，一些人喜歡吃生大蒜，而不是把大蒜放在菜裡。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zài zhōng guó běi fāng yì xiē rén xǐ huan chī shēng dà suàn ér bú shì bǎ dà suàn fàng zài cài lǐ
sentences.english: Garlic. A lot of people eat garlic, and garlic is actually not too weird.

sentences.simplified: 喜欢吃生大蒜的人觉得大蒜很香，特别是和肉，还有面条一起吃的时候。
sentences.traditional: 喜歡吃生大蒜的人覺得大蒜很香，特別是和肉，還有麵條一起吃的時候。
sentences.pinyin: xǐ huan chī shēng dà suàn de rén jué de dà suàn hěn xiāng tè bié shì hé ròu hái yǒu miàn tiáo yì qǐ chī de shí hou
sentences.english: However, in northern China, some people prefer to eat raw garlic instead of putting it in their dishes.
People who like raw garlic find it very aromatic, especially when eaten with meat and also noodles.

sentences.simplified: 鸡爪。和其他奇葩食物不一样，很多中国人都喜欢吃鸡爪。
sentences.traditional: 雞爪。和其他奇葩食物不一樣，很多中國人都喜歡吃雞爪。
sentences.pinyin: jī zhuǎ hé qí tā qí pā shí wù bù yí yàng hěn duō zhōng guó rén dōu xǐ huan chī jī zhuǎ

sentences.simplified: 其实在中国，鸡爪不是奇葩食物，是很常见的。
sentences.traditional: 其實在中國，雞爪不是奇葩食物，是很常見的。
sentences.pinyin: qí shí zài zhōng guó jī zhuǎ bú shì qí pā shí wù shì hěn cháng jiàn de
sentences.english: Chicken feet. Unlike other weird foods, many Chinese people like to eat chicken feet.

sentences.simplified: 大家喜欢在饭店里一边吃米饭一边吃鸡爪；
sentences.traditional: 大家喜歡在飯店裡一邊吃米飯一邊吃雞爪；
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā xǐ huan zài fàn diàn lǐ yì biān chī mǐ fàn yì biān chī jī zhuǎ
sentences.english: In fact, in China, chicken feet are not a weird food and are very common.

sentences.simplified: 也喜欢在家里一边看电视一边吃鸡爪。
sentences.traditional: 也喜歡在家裡一邊看電視一邊吃雞爪。
sentences.pinyin: yě xǐ huan zài jiā lǐ yì biān kàn diàn shì yì biān chī jī zhuǎ
sentences.english: People like to eat chicken feet in restaurants while eating rice.
They also like to eat chicken feet at home while watching TV.

sentences.simplified: 这些是最有名的中国奇葩食物，
sentences.traditional: 這些是最有名的中國奇葩食物，
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē shì zuì yǒu míng de zhōng guó qí pā shí wù

sentences.simplified: 还有一些不那么有名的奇葩食物，如果想知道更多，可以上网看看。
sentences.traditional: 還有一些不那麼有名的奇葩食物，如果想知道更多，可以上網看看。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yì xiē bú nà me yǒu míng de qí pā shí wù rú guǒ xiǎng zhī dào gèng duō kě yǐ shàng wǎng kàn kan
sentences.english: These are the most famous weird foods in China.

sentences.simplified: 虽然这些食物听起来很奇葩，但喜欢它们的人非常爱吃这些食物。
sentences.traditional: 雖然這些食物聽起來很奇葩，但喜歡它們的人非常愛吃這些食物。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zhè xiē shí wù tīng qǐ lái hěn qí pā dàn xǐ huan tā men de rén fēi cháng ài chī zhè xiē shí wù
sentences.english: There are also some less famous weird foods. If you want to know more, you can look online.

sentences.simplified: 如果你来到中国，可以试试这些特别的食物，也许你会发现自己喜欢上了它们。
sentences.traditional: 如果你來到中國，可以試試這些特別的食物，也許你會發現自己喜歡上了它們。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ lái dào zhōng guó kě yǐ shì shi zhè xiē tè bié de shí wù yě xǔ nǐ huì fā xiàn zì jǐ xǐ huan shàng le tā men
sentences.english: Although these foods sound weird, the people who like them love these foods very much.

sentence_translations: China Weird Food Map
Food is something we all can’t live without. Different countries have different foods and their own food cultures.
China is the same. Not only does it have a lot of food, but each place has a different food culture.
Among these food cultures, “weird food” is the most special.
Weird foods are different from other foods.
People who like these foods like them a lot, and people who don’t like these foods are afraid of them.
Weird foods are available in many places because every place has some people who like them and will look for places that sell these foods.
It is difficult to say where these weird foods come from. Here are only a few of the most famous.
Century eggs. A century egg is a black-looking egg that has a very special taste.
The first people who made century eggs were from Jiangsu.
People put the eggs in ash, and after a few months, the eggs turned black.
Nowadays, people often eat century eggs while drinking beer.
Some people cook with century eggs, and some people put century eggs in rice.
Stinky tofu. Stinky tofu, as you can tell by the name, is a very smelly tofu.
The most famous stinky tofu is in Hunan. People in Hunan often deep-fry stinky tofu and put some greens on it.
People who like to eat stinky tofu say that it actually does not taste stinky.
Garlic. A lot of people eat garlic, and garlic is actually not too weird.
However, in northern China, some people prefer to eat raw garlic instead of putting it in their dishes.
People who like raw garlic find it very aromatic, especially when eaten with meat and also noodles.
Chicken feet. Unlike other weird foods, many Chinese people like to eat chicken feet.
In fact, in China, chicken feet are not a weird food and are very common.
People like to eat chicken feet in restaurants while eating rice.
They also like to eat chicken feet at home while watching TV.
These are the most famous weird foods in China.
There are also some less famous weird foods. If you want to know more, you can look online.
Although these foods sound weird, the people who like them love these foods very much.
If you come to China, try these special foods. Maybe you will discover that you like them.
